title: Start all Docker-managed kiosk components with one Compose command
user_visible_behavior: so that deployment and restart are repeatable
verification_command: docker compose up -d --wait --wait-timeout 120 && docker compose ps

title: Call the kiosk API through https://kiosk-api.alpa.vn
user_visible_behavior: so that the kiosk can be reached without opening inbound router ports
verification_command: Authenticated GET /api/v1/ping returns 200, while the same request without X-API-Key returns 401 and no management service is public

title: Supervise ArmController as a native Windows service
user_visible_behavior: so that robot control remains .NET Framework compatible and recovers after reboot
verification_command: ArmController service is running within 60 seconds of the defined boot readiness point and restarts a killed process within 10 seconds

title: Preserve database and broker state across container recreation
user_visible_behavior: so that operational data is not erased unintentionally
verification_command: PostgreSQL, CouchDB, Redis, and RabbitMQ retain test state after docker compose down followed by docker compose up -d without -v
